methodology.source_policy: Used selected public Food Network and Good Housekeeping editorial/affiliate roundups. Did not bulk crawl or reuse competitors' prose, images, or tracking IDs. Bare ASINs were copied from source-page product links.
methodology.scoring: Weighted heuristic: demand evidence 25%, audience fit 25%, purchase intent 20%, content gap/competition 15%, affiliate/editorial suitability 15%. A score is a comparative research estimate, not a sales forecast.
methodology.demand_limits: Roundup placement, ratings, and review counts are dated third-party source statements, not current Amazon sales, conversion, rank, or availability. No sales volume is inferred.
methodology.pinterest_trends: Pinterest Spring Trend Report 2026 reports cozy food, creative dining, kitchen comfort and pantry-staple themes. This informs creative direction only, not demand scores.
methodology.publication_gate: Before publishing any Pin, confirm the ASIN title and variant on the live Amazon page, check seller/availability, ensure the matching site product page exists, create an original or licensed image, and review Pinterest disclosure and spam guidance. Pin copy is draft only.
